dump_metric_record: dump a metrics record with a kind label and arbitrary keyword arguments to a JSONL file
dump_metric_with_env: dump a metric record that auto-opens the file path from the FG_METRICS environment variable
check_recording_status: check whether metrics recording is currently active by calling the recording function
dump_metric_disabled: dump a metric record that safely returns early when metrics are disabled
review_dump_function: review the dump function to understand how it writes JSON records with rank and timestamp
